name: Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells 3D printers and related accessories worldwide. It offers products, such as fused filament fabrication (FFF) 3D printers, resin 3D printers, 3D scanners, filaments, and accessories; laser engravers, creality cloud, a platform focused on 3D printing content; nexbie, an overseas e-commerce platform dedicated to 3D creative items; creality Print, a slicing software (slicer). The company serves individual consumers, hobbyists, educators, and small businesses for daily creative projects, prototyping, lightweight commercial applications, automotive, aerospace, medical, and architecture.
